decisions.statement: A row is dragged through the drag and drop the tree view already gives.
The drag is carried under the name the editor gives a tree of this view's name.
One row is dragged at a time.
A row's initiative and place are read off the key that row has.
A key is its initiative's slug and a mark and the place counted from `1`.
A drop onto an intent of the same initiative moves the intent among that initiative's intents.
A drop onto the place the dragged intent sits at already moves nothing.
A drop onto an intent of another initiative hands the intent to that initiative.
A drop onto another initiative's own row hands the intent to that initiative.
An initiative stating no intent is reached by dropping onto its own row.
A drop onto the row of the initiative already stating the intent does nothing.
Which row of an initiative a drop lands on sets no place among its intents.
The intent handed over is named by the statement its row is drawn under.
A drop over no row at all moves nothing and hands nothing.
The move is made by the command that moves an intent.
The hand is made by the command that hands an intent to another initiative.
A move that failed is said to Alan once and written to the panel's channel.
A hand that failed is said to Alan once and written to that same channel.
The editor is handed in rather than imported.
The harness call is handed in rather than imported.
Each command asked is named by reading the slug off that command's own page.
Nothing here writes the initiative's page.
No row is composed here.
A drop tells the panel to draw the new order before the move is made.
A drop returns before the command answers.
A drop waits the ceiling the harness names rather than a ceiling named here.
A drop tells the panel the intent is leaving before the hand is made.
A refused move or hand tells the panel to let go of the hold.
A move or hand the command answered is told to the panel as answered.
The intent moved is named by the statement its row is drawn under.
The place the intent leaves is named to no command.
A row drawn under no label is moved nowhere and handed nowhere.
A refusal saying a body moved between the read and the write is said to Alan as one sentence.
That refusal is known by the words the freshness rules close that refusal with.
The sentence said in place of that refusal is handed over rather than held here.
Every other refusal reaches Alan in the words that refusal was made in.
The channel is written the whole refusal whichever words Alan is shown.

definition: the row dragged in the work tree read as one intent's new place or new initiative
